merges.name: Suppressor-Gated SASA
merges.transfer: L1 penalty = CO2 suppressor; rank-adaptive regularizer detects intrinsic-dim threshold crossing and DROPS L1 on that subspace -> feature 'fruits' as coherent d-dim decoder (suppressor-removal trigger, not reward)

merges.name: Patriline Acquisition Scheduler
merges.transfer: 3 acquisition terms (repr/info/de-amp) given staggered activation temperatures like patriline fanning thresholds -> graduated cascade prevents covariate-shift overcorrection oscillation; no single criterion dominates globally
merges.artifact: PAS wrapper: staggered-temperature softmax over repr(MMD)/info(BALD)/deamp scores; test on misspecified sinusoidal regression vs flat R-IDeA

merges.name: Martempered Dataset Distillation
merges.transfer: hold synthetic data FROZEN while model layers equilibrate (CKA variance < eps) -> THEN jointly re-optimize so all layers encode a consistent low-dim subspace together (avoids 'differential-stress' subspace mismatch)
merges.artifact: MDD: CKA-equilibration gate between freeze/quench phases; test cross-arch transfer (ResNet->ConvNet) vs DSA baseline

merges.name: Topological-Gate BPE
merges.transfer: purl/tuck topological cohesion gate that BOUNDS defect propagation = z-stat cohesion gate that bounds the merge frontier; local cohesion test replaces greedy global frequency criterion
merges.artifact: z-gated BPE: merge only if adjacency z>z* (else 'purl-blocked'); WikiText-103 BPC/perplexity vs vanilla BPE

merges.name: TonalMark

merges.artifact: TonalMark: encode 64-bit ID as structured perturbation in top-k generalized-eigvec subspace; recovery vs finetune/INT4-quant; sweep k for capacity/robustness knee

merges.name: BrineBase
merges.transfer: house-flora attractor that outcompetes naive inoculants = kNN plan-memory attractor that overrides naive optimizer plan via neighborhood voting; 'back-slop ratio' = kNN-confidence override gate

merges.name: Fixed-Quota Release
merges.transfer: eliminate PARTICIPATION VARIANCE (fixed quota beats Poisson) = layered orthoester hydrolysis rates give each note a fixed release quota per time-bin, decoupling schedule from volatility; variance-elimination maximizes both 'utility' and 'budget'
merges.artifact: FQORS formulation: orthoesters with staggered t1/2 set for equal mole-fraction/bin; GC-MS flat-AUC vs Poisson-analog control (a chemistry demo of the BIS variance argument)

merges.name: Semantic-VMG Decoding
merges.transfer: greedy token = pointing-directly-at-goal (kills semantic progress); optimal = tangent-point token maximizing p(t)*cos(fingerprint(t), goal_circuit_dir) -- strictly oblique to both highest-prob and most-aligned, like VMG=speed*cos(TWA)
